lead.question: 作者如何看待国际层面的体育运动？它真能增进国家间的友谊吗？
lead.warmup: 乔治·奥威尔在文中挑战一个流行的信念：体育能促进国家间的友谊。他冷峻地指出，国际赛场往往不是友谊的舞台，而是仇恨与对抗的温床。本课带你走近"体育精神"的另一面，在品味其犀利论证的同时，掌握让步从句、虚拟语气与分词等语法要点，并积累竞争、荣誉类词汇。
goals: 理解奥威尔反驳"体育创造国家友谊"的论证逻辑与立场。
掌握 competitive、prestige、rivalry、spectator 等本课核心词汇。
学会 even if 引导的让步从句与 if only 的条件/虚拟用法。
辨析 unless 引导的反向条件句及分词短语作定语、状语的表达。
lead.summary: 作者反驳体育创造国家友谊之说：国际比赛往往引发疯狂仇恨，1936 年奥运会便是明证。他指出，当今体育几乎都是竞争性的，参赛只为取胜。在乡村草坪上可只为娱乐踢球，但一旦涉及荣誉与声望、想到会因输而丢脸，好斗本能便被激发。在国际层面，体育简直是模拟战争，各国为荒唐的比赛如痴如狂，甚至把跑跳踢球当作民族品德的检验。
lead.tips: 区分 if only 的两种用法：单独成句表虚拟愿望（If only I could fly.），引导条件时等于 as long as，后面必须有主句，如 if only the common peoples could meet one another。

questions.q: How does the writer describe sport at the international level?
questions.zh: 作者如何描述国际层面的体育运动？
questions.a: He says that at the international level sport is frankly mimic warfare.
questions.aZh: 他说，在国际层面，体育简直是一场模拟战争。
questions.hint: 答案见课文：At the international level, sport is frankly mimic warfare.

questions.q: What concrete example does the writer give of international contests leading to orgies of hatred?
questions.zh: 作者举出什么具体事例说明国际比赛会导致疯狂的仇恨？
questions.hint: 见第二句括号中 the 1936 Olympic Games, for instance。

questions.q: According to the writer, when is it possible to play simply for the fun and exercise?
questions.zh: 按照作者的观点，什么时候才可能单纯为了娱乐和锻炼而比赛？
questions.a: On the village green, where you pick up sides and no feeling of local patriotism is involved.
questions.aZh: 在乡间的草坪上，当你随意组队、不涉及地方情绪的时候。
questions.hint: 见第五句前半 On the village green, where...。

questions.q: What happens as soon as the question of prestige arises?
questions.zh: 一旦涉及荣誉与声望的问题，会发生什么？
questions.a: The most savage combative instincts are aroused.
questions.aZh: 最野蛮的争斗天性便会被激发起来。
questions.hint: 见第五句后半 as soon as the question of prestige arises...。

questions.q: Do you agree that international sport is a form of warfare rather than a creator of goodwill?
questions.zh: 你同意作者的观点吗——国际体育是某种形式的战争，而不是友谊的缔造者？
questions.a: Open answer. One view: sport can rouse fierce rivalry and national pride, yet it also builds ties; the writer deliberately stresses the darker side.
questions.aZh: 开放性问题。一种看法：体育确实会激起强烈的对抗和民族荣誉感，但也能建立联系；作者有意突出其阴暗的一面。
questions.hint: 结合首句 goodwill 与末句 tests of national virtue 的矛盾作答。

exercises.q: 汉译英：体育运动能创造国家之间的友谊。
exercises.a: Sport creates goodwill between the nations.

exercises.q: 汉译英：如今开展的体育运动几乎都是竞争性的，参赛就是为了取胜。
exercises.a: Nearly all the sports practised nowadays are competitive. You play to win.
exercises.note: practised 过去分词作后置定语

exercises.q: 填空：Even if one didn't know from concrete examples, one could ____ it from general principles.（填入"推断出"）
填空：You play to win, and the game has little meaning ____ you do your utmost to win.
句型转换：用 if only 改写 "If the common peoples could meet one another at football, they would have no inclination to meet on the battlefield."
exercises.a: If only the common peoples could meet one another at football, they would have no inclination to meet on the battlefield.
exercises.note: if only 作条件句＝as long as

exercises.q: 改错：As soon as the question of prestige arise, the most savage combative instincts are aroused.
汉译英：在国际层面上，体育简直是一场模拟战争。
exercises.a: At the international level, sport is frankly mimic warfare.
exercises.note: frankly 直率地；mimic 模拟的

quiz.q: 作者用哪个短语形容国际层面的体育？
quiz.note: 课文原句：sport is frankly mimic warfare

quiz.q: 作者举出哪个例子说明国际比赛会导致疯狂的仇恨？
quiz.note: 1936 年奥运会是文中具体事例

quiz.q: "Nearly all the sports practised nowadays are competitive." 中 practised 的作用是？
quiz.note: practised 修饰 sports，作后置定语

quiz.q: 下列哪句体现了"反向条件"（unless）？
options: The game has little meaning unless you do your utmost to win.
If only I had a pair of wings.
Even if one didn't know, one could deduce it.

quiz.q: 按作者所说，一旦涉及荣誉与声望，会发生什么？
options: 最野蛮的好斗本能被激发
quiz.note: the most savage combative instincts are aroused
